1: // Minimal Space Debris Dodger game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 400;
7:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
8: 
9:   // ---- Game objects ----
10:   const ship = { x: W/2, y: H-30, w: 30, h: 15, speed: 4, health: 3 };
11:   const bullets = [];
12:   const debris = [];
13: 
14:   // ---- Input handling ----
15:   const keys = {};
16:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => keys[e.code] = true);
17:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.code] = false);
18: 
19:   // ---- Helpers ----
20:   function rect(o) { return {x:o.x, y:o.y, w:o.w, h:o.h}; }
21:   function intersect(a,b) {
22:     return a.x < b.x+b.w && a.x+a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y+b.h && a.y+a.h > b.y;
23:   }
24: 
25:   // ---- Game loop ----
26:   let frames = 0;
27:   function loop(){
28:     // move ship
29:     if(keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.x = Math.max(0, ship.x - ship.speed);
30:     if(keys['ArrowRight']) ship.x = Math.min(W-ship.w, ship.x + ship.speed);
31:     if(keys['Space']) {
32:       // fire rate limit
33:       if(frames % 10 === 0) bullets.push({x: ship.x+ship.w/2-2, y: ship.y, w:4, h:10, speed:6});
34:     }
35:     // update bullets
36:     for(let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
37:       const b=bullets[i];
38:       b.y -= b.speed;
39:       if(b.y < -b.h) bullets.splice(i,1);
40:     }
41:     // spawn debris
42:     if(frames % Math.max(30, 120 - ship.health*20) === 0) {
43:       const size = 20 + Math.random()*15;
44:       debris.push({x: Math.random()*(W-size), y: -size, w:size, h:size, speed:2+Math.random()*2});
45:     }
46:     // update debris
47:     for(let i=debris.length-1;i>=0;i--){
48:       const d=debris[i];
49:       d.y += d.speed;
50:       // collision with ship
51:       if(intersect(rect(d), rect(ship))) { ship.health--; debris.splice(i,1); }
52:       // collision with bullets
53:       for(let j=bullets.length-1;j>=0;j--){
54:         if(intersect(rect(d), rect(bullets[j]))) { debris.splice(i,1); bullets.splice(j,1); break; }
55:       }
56:       // remove off‑screen
57:       if(d.y>H) debris.splice(i,1);
58:     }
59:     // draw
60:     ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
61:     // ship
62:     ctx.fillStyle='white';
63:     ctx.fillRect(ship.x, ship.y, ship.w, ship.h);
64:     // bullets
65:     ctx.fillStyle='lime';
66:     bullets.forEach(b=>ctx.fillRect(b.x,b.y,b.w,b.h));
67:     // debris
68:     ctx.fillStyle='red';
69:     debris.forEach(d=>ctx.fillRect(d.x,d.y,d.w,d.h));
70:     // health
71:     ctx.fillStyle='yellow';
72:     ctx.font='16px monospace';
73:     ctx.fillText('Health: '+ship.health,10,20);
74: 
75:     if(ship.health>0) {
76:       frames++;
77:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
78:     } else {
79:       ctx.fillStyle='white';
80:       ctx.textAlign='center';
81:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W/2, H/2);
82:     }
83:   }
84:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
85: })();

(End of file - total 85 lines)
</content>
